lineup.campaignCore: {{name}} is a core character of this campaign.

campaign.label: Campaign
campaign.replaces: Choosing a campaign replaces the lineup with its core characters.

incursion.label: Incursions
incursion.noShared: These Incursions have no faction in common.
incursion.clears: Changing the Incursions clears the lineup.

picker.label: Add units
picker.noRoster: Without a synced roster, every unit is listed.

nameLength.reason: The name must be 3 to 40 characters.

tooFewCharacters.reason: A team needs at least 3 characters. Machines of War don't count.

unknownUnit.reason: A unit is no longer in the game data.

modeNotCombinable.reason: Campaign and Incursion teams can't have other modes.
modeNotCombinable.fix: Keep only one of those modes.

tooManyCoreCharacters.reason: A war or Tournament Arena team can have at most 5 core characters.

tooManyCoreMows.reason: A war or Tournament Arena team can have at most one core Machine of War.

mowsNotAllowed.reason: Campaign and Incursion teams have no Machine of War.

campaignRequired.reason: A Campaign team needs a campaign, and other teams can't have one.
campaignRequired.fix: Choose a campaign, or clear it.

unknownCampaign.reason: This campaign isn't in the game data.

coreCharacterMissing.reason: Every core character of the campaign must be in the core.
coreCharacterMissing.fix: Add the characters marked “Must be core” as core.

factionNotAllowed.reason: Some characters are from factions this team can't field.

incursionRequired.reason: An Incursion team needs at least one Incursion, and other teams can't have one.
incursionRequired.fix: Choose an Incursion, or clear them.

unknownIncursion.reason: An Incursion isn't in the game data.

noSharedIncursionFaction.reason: These Incursions have no faction in common.

mode.title: Filter by mode
mode.content: Show only the teams for one game mode. This device remembers your choice.

view.title: Group and lay out
view.content: Group teams by mode or list them in play order, as cards or a table.

create.title: Create a team
create.content: Build a lineup for one or more modes. You can keep up to 20 teams.

card.title: A team
card.content: Its modes, core and flex characters, and Machines of War. A team that breaks a rule says how to fix it.

reorder.title: Order your teams
reorder.content: Drag a team by the grip beside its number. Under a filter or a mode section, teams move only among the ones shown.
